name: New York

sources.label: NYSED — Graduation Requirements (credit and assessment requirements)
NYSED — NY Inspires memo: Sunsetting Diploma Assessment Requirements and Moving to One Diploma (Sept. 28, 2026)

plans.name: Regents Diploma (graduating before January 2028)

subjects.label: Social Studies
subjects.notes: U.S. History 1, Global History and Geography 2, Participation in Government 0.5, Economics 0.5

subjects.label: Science
subjects.notes: Life Science 1, Physical Science 1, and 1 more in either

subjects.label: World Languages
subjects.notes: A student's IEP may excuse this credit; they still need 22 credits.

subjects.label: The Arts
subjects.notes: Dance, media arts, music, theater, or visual arts

subjects.label: Physical Education
subjects.notes: Take PE every semester; each semester earns 1/4 credit.

plans.notes: Includes 3.5 elective credits. You must also pass the 4+1 exams: one Regents exam (or approved alternative) each in English language arts, math, science, and social studies, plus one pathway. Eligible students may use appeals, safety nets, or superintendent determination.

plans.name: Regents Diploma with Advanced Designation (graduating before January 2028)

subjects.label: Social Studies
subjects.notes: U.S. History 1, Global History and Geography 2, Participation in Government 0.5, Economics 0.5

subjects.label: Science
subjects.notes: Life Science 1, Physical Science 1, and 1 more in either

subjects.label: World Languages
subjects.notes: Or 3 credits total plus the Checkpoint B exam if you use world languages as your sequence

subjects.label: The Arts
subjects.notes: Dance, media arts, music, theater, or visual arts

subjects.label: Physical Education
subjects.notes: Take PE every semester; each semester earns 1/4 credit.

plans.notes: Same 22 credits as the Regents Diploma (3.5 electives). Exams: English language arts, three math, one life science, one physical science, and one social studies Regents exam (or approved alternatives), plus one pathway. You must also finish one sequence: 3 total world language credits plus the local Checkpoint B exam, a 5-unit arts sequence, or a 5-unit CTE sequence.

plans.name: New York State Diploma (graduating January 2028 or later)

subjects.label: Social Studies
subjects.notes: U.S. History 1, Global History and Geography 2, Participation in Government 0.5, Economics 0.5

subjects.label: Science
subjects.notes: Life Science 1, Physical Science 1, and 1 more in either

plans.notes: Starting in 2027-28, New York replaces its Local, Regents, and Advanced Designation diplomas with one diploma. Students graduating in January 2028 or later do not have to pass the 4+1 Regents exams. NYSED says the current 22-credit rules stay in place for everyone now in high school until new competency-based rules arrive with full rollout in 2029-30.

otherRequirements: Graduating before January 2028: pass the required Regents exams (or approved alternatives) for your diploma type, plus one pathway
Graduating January 2028 or later: Regents exams are still given but passing them is no longer a diploma requirement
districtNote: NYSED says schools and districts may add diploma requirements on top of the state minimum, so check your school's own rules.
